About

Health data.
Scientific expertise.
Practical technology.

Geniva develops software, builds computing infrastructure and provides training for health data analysis, interpretation and reporting.

Three areas of expertise.
A shared purpose.

Geniva Bilişim Sağlık A.Ş. brings software, hardware and education together to support healthcare organisations, laboratories and research teams working with complex health data.

Gennext is our software product for clinical genomics and longevity. Our computing infrastructure and training complement the platform, helping teams connect data processing with evaluation and reporting.

Explore our solutions

OUR SCIENTIFIC APPROACH

Considering the layers
of biology together.

Our multi-omics approach considers genomic, transcriptomic, epigenetic, metabolomic and lipidomic data in a shared biological context, around the question each study seeks to answer.

LABORATORY CAPABILITY

Laboratory work
that supports our solutions.

Our own laboratory carries out microarray genotyping, DNA methylation work and Nanopore long-read sequencing. This capacity supports our longevity analysis and reporting workflows.
